QuestInfo.name: Mind Eraser, No Chaser
QuestInfo.0: #p2450000# was revealed to be nothing more than a victim of dark Shadow Knight magic. He was lucky to escape the explosion unscathed. #b#p2450040##k would know his current whereabouts.
QuestInfo.1: #p2450040#'s analysis of #p2450000# was terrible news. Whatever the Shadow Knights had done during the brainwashing process was destroying the poor man's sanity. She recommended an immediate dose of memory-erasing potion. They would need to get a supply of #b#t4033860##k from the #r#o2600425##k monsters in #b#MDmirrorD_325_3_##k of #b#m325000000##k to save him.
QuestInfo.2: With the items in hand, #p2450040# set out to make the concoction that would erase #p2450000#'s memory.

0.0: His mental state is... It's just a mess. Whatever they did to him has caused irreparable damage, the kind that's just going to get worse. But we can stop it. It's just going to take... #rerasing his memories#k.
0.1: I know, I know. That sounds horrible, but it's the only thing I can see as a doctor that will stop his descent into madness. It will be a dangerous procedure, but I just know that I can save this man, if you two will help.

yes.0: There is a creature called the #r#o2600425##k at the end of #b#MDmirrorD_325_3_##k that will have the #b#t4033860##k I need. Please hurry...
